title: Gregory Chaitin - Is Mathematics Invented or Discovered?
summary: Gregory Chaitin is interviewed on Closer To Truth about whether mathematics is invented or discovered. He gives a nuanced view that ties the question to the nature of reality.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a thoughtful and nuanced take on the philosophy of mathematics.

quote.text: The whole interview is actually quite nuanced on the question of whether math is discovered or invented and well worth a watch
